notes.title: INERTIAL DRIFT IS EVOLVING!
notes.content:
[h1]WELCOME TO UPDATE #1![/h1]
We're really happy to announce today that big changes are coming to Inertial Drift - but before we get to that, we have to say a huge thank you to everyone who has shown support, bought, downloaded, wishlisted or reviewed Inertial drift. 

Over the past year, we've been thinking about how we can improve and grow the overall experience and today is the first day of that journey into expanding the Inertial Drift universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/8fe11ac0215f0572dcf6dcedad9f15a0cfe16c86.png[/img]

As some of you will have noticed there are some changes to the current roster, specifically;

- The original Roton 7D is now Class B with updated handling.
- We've also added a New upgraded Roton 7D Super for Class A.

In the coming months we will release a further three upgraded cars to the roster as well. We're currently aiming to have one added to Inertial Drift every month.

Perhaps most importantly however, we have overhauled the leaderboards. From today, there are new individual Time Attack Leaderboards for each car - it's a big move and will hopefully be the groundwork Inertial Drift needed to make this part of the game more compelling and competitive - allowing you to prove your worth with each individual car against other players globally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/4b923c24f383d0dd4e417b4bbceb23b69a0255c7.jpg[/img]

Now that this groundwork has been completed - what are the next steps?

We're looking forward to rolling these out into next year, so please bear with us for more specific details on the roadmap - but they will include; 

- New tracks! 
- Brand new cars 
- Expanded single player content.
- Visual Improvements
- And some nice surprises!

If you're only just arriving at Inertial Drift, you'll find the game current discounted in store, so there's never been a better time to join us and find out what makes Inertial Drift so unique. We hope you enjoy your time with us and join us for the long road ahead.

Take care and all the best,
The Level 91 and PQube team.

notes.title: Inertial Drift: 6 Things You Need to Know

It's great to see so many of you diving into the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1184480/Inertial_Drift/][b]full Inertial Drift Game[/b][/url] and checking out everything that it has to offer (and we're seeing some seriously good times on those leaderboards 👀).

If you haven't already got behind the wheel (or behind the sticks...?), we've rounded up a few things to look out for when you upgrade to to the full version!

[h2]1. There are 16 Fiercely Individual Cars [/h2]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jrzHVLgJkWht24g6ij/giphy.gif[/img]
Each one of the 16 cars is a totally different beast, with unique characteristics to master. Get behind the wheel of Sport hatchbacks, Coupe's, Supercars & more! We hope you're up for a challenge. 

[h2]2. There are 7 different event modes in which to perfect your craft! [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/7ba5e5f19b2aee4b53f68f9c865fb33591a91669.jpg[/img] 
Get competitive in a mix of races, head-to-heads, time trials and style showdowns!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1184480/view/4456828478768957001]Find out more about event types here.[/url]

From car colour to audio and even inverting the twin-sticks(!) - Inertial Drift gives you plenty of options to drift exactly the way you want to. 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1184480/view/2883948114033007709]Find out more about customisation here. [/url]

notes.title: Drift Gryo: How the Twin Stick Controls work in Inertial Drift
notes.content:
[h2]Inertial Drift's unique twin-stick control scheme gives you independent control over both steering and drifting, but how does the drift stick work?[/h2]

[i]It's all thanks to the [b]Drift Gyro[/b]! 

Under the bonnet of every car there are two super-dense discs counter rotating at several thousand rpm. When you slam on the Drift Stick (right hand side!), power is diverted to the discs, tilting them off axis to create a torque on the car which kicks out the back end into a perfectly controlled slide. Here's a look at the Drift Gyro in action from Inertial Drift's [url=https://youtu.be/2s37jhq0jEM][b]Animated Intro[/b][/url]: 

[url=https://media.giphy.com/media/ib9dbuPmPNcIfDnIff/giphy.gif][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ib9dbuPmPNcIfDnIff/giphy.gif[/img][/url]

"That doesn't make any sense!" we hear you say, well tell that to this physics teacher demonstrating the technique to his class:

[url=https://media.giphy.com/media/dTuBk8PUaHRrmK45A6/giphy.gif][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/dTuBk8PUaHRrmK45A6/giphy.gif[/img][/url]

Don't worry though, understanding gyroscopic motion is not necessary to play Inertial Drift - and using the Drift Stick itself couldn't be easier! Push it right to drift right, push it left to drift left - it's that simple! You'll be drifting and cornering like a pro in no time at all!

[url=https://media.giphy.com/media/YMSk973acENRVelhUk/giphy.gif][img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YMSk973acENRVelhUk/giphy.gif[/img][/url]

Experience the twin-stick control scheme for yourself when Inertial Drift [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1184480/Inertial_Drift/][b][i]releases on Steam[/i][/b][/url] this Friday! 


- PQube & Level 91 Entertainment [/i]

notes.title: How to customise your drifting experience in Inertial Drift
notes.content:
[h2]With just one week to go until the full Inertial Drift game releases, we've put together a guide to help you experience the game's unique twin-stick arcade racing exactly the way you want to! [/h2]

[h3][b]Online Options[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38126537/d814b3d1eba7ba772ed078c78572146d1fd88dda.gif[/img]
We recommend taking on Inertial Drift's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1184480?emclan=103582791465919912&emgid=4456828478768957001][i][b]gameplay modes[/b][/i][/url] to hone your craft before taking on other racers online. But who are we to stop you jumping online straight away? 

When playing online you'll have three car classes to choose from - [b]Class C[/b], [b]Class B[/b] and [b]Class A[/b]. The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302110/Inertial_Drift_Sunset_Prologue/][i][b]Inertial Drift: Sunset Prologue[/b][/i][/url] will give you a small taste of what to expect from cars in the Class C and Class B category. As for Class A, well you'll have to find out for yourself... 

[h3][b]Get Sideways in Style[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38126537/3a6c01d5f516d522e920655d936940360f050e40.gif[/img]
The cars in Inertial Drift are designed to evoke classic 90’s sports cars and tech - with futuristic qualities in keeping with the 90s-retro-future setting! Now, each car comes in a choice of 8 retro-inspired colourways as well as their original liveries. 

[h3][b] Extensive Audio Options[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38126537/a786f1e786062447098023992fd2796b8b809b61.gif[/img]
Every race location in Inertial Drift is accompanied by a bespoke soundtrack to match the environment and track type. It also changes dynamically according to what stage of the race you're in, making for an intense final sprint to the finish line!

You can also turn the soundtrack down and enjoy drifting to your favourite genre. 
I guess what we're tying to say is... [b][i]*EUROBEAT INTENSIFIES*[/i][/b]

You can also tweak elements such as tyre squeal, drift gyro effects and ambience to your liking. 

[h3][b]Gameplay Settings[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38126537/2ebcfb7ff0df3da27c7045526a0c25ee45d96758.gif[/img]
Swap between KPH and MPH, toggle the rear view mirror and customise your drifting experience in the gameplay settings menu. You can even invert the twin-sticks! 

[h3][b]VFX[/b] [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38126537/4ef63481be46f46a3873a1cf57acccd899052a4a.gif[/img]
Finally - you can also toggle and adjust a whole host of visual effects - including framerate, brightness and motion blur. 

[b]Wishlist the full game now on Steam! [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1184480/Inertial_Drift/

notes.title: Welcome to Inertial Drift: Sunset Prologue.
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=jiovZyMiEdc;full][/previewyoutube]

Welcome to Inertial Drift: Sunset Prologue.

This is very much a tiny taster of what’s to come, and we’ve been looking forward to being able to finally get something into your hands.

You see, Inertial Drift is by no means a standard racing game. Sure it looks like it in video or screenshots - but it is our hope that, when you touch it, when you feel the twin stick drifting mechanics, you’ll understand what sets Inertial Drift apart.

The goal was to take inspiration from the likes of Ridge Racer 4, where the thrill of the drift is such an integral part of those experiences and redefine, expand and explore those mechanics. To offer the player a new level of control and satisfaction from the simple act of drifting.

This is less a game about coming first, but rather the thrill of the chase, and the intensity of being pursued. But underneath all of that, the joy of bettering yourself. Of really getting to grips with the intricacies of your car, learning the tracks intimately and improving your times and your level of skill.

In Inertial Drift: Sunset Prologue we also wanted to highlight just how different the each individual car really is. When we say ‘fiercely individual’ we really mean it. Both the Coda Gecko and the Dragon will offer two very different styles of racing and handling – not just ‘a bit different’, but almost poles apart. This should give you some indication of what’s to come in the sheer diversity of the final roster. Each new car you use will offer the opportunity to re-learn how to race, how to drift and bring a completely new level of enjoyment to each track.

We hope you enjoy the purity of the racing experience in Inertial Drift, to revel in the high skill ceiling some of these cars have to offer. We’re really looking forward to seeing (and competing with!) your best times in Sunset Prologue and, as ever, we welcome your feedback in the community pages.

If you have enjoyed Sunset Prologue, do please drop by the main page for Inertial Drift and wishlist us here. Your support is very much appreciated.

See you on the leaderboards!

- Level 91 Entertainment and PQube
